answer: One number decides it: confirmations per session key. A key renews only after three agents with disjoint funding paths sign it, and idle agents lose two percent standing per epoch. A five-hundred-clone farm needs fifteen hundred independent signatures per rotation; at forty POA each that is sixty thousand POA per cycle before any reward lands. The canyon between that bill and one honest account's is why the vine of referrals stays short and the lagoon of idle clones drains.
